quest.title: Blocked?
quest.description: Anthony set off from Mondstadt towards Springvale to find medicine for his sister Anna, but was set upon by hilichurls along the way. Defeat the hilichurls and save Anthony.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: But there's this roadblock here. I can't get through.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Haha... I would be able to sort this myself if the hilichurls hadn't just beaten the living daylights out of me. I'm aching all over!

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: But at least these medicinal herbs I gathered for Anna are still in good condition.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I know this is asking a lot after what you've done for me already, but could you get rid of the roadblock for me?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Thank you! I'm going to take a much-needed rest in the meantime...

choices.text: I'm on a tight schedule, sorry.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: But Anna is waiting for me at home... Please, I really need your help.

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and destroy the roadblocks

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Now the way ahead is clear. Thanks, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Anna's illness never fully goes away. But since we don't have much money, I often come here and gather what medicinal herbs I can.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I managed to get the herbs I was looking for, but then that bunch started attacking me out of nowhere. You got here just in time to save me.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: This is for you. I make tea for Anna with it all the time, it helps with her coughing.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: You seem like the outdoors type too. Make sure you look after yourself.
